//: IDE-side protections. The threat here is not malice — it is that a developer's
editor is where secrets get pasted, where AI assistants read context, and where
generated code lands before any gate sees it.
Checked in deliberately: an IDE control that each developer must configure
themselves is a control most developers will not have.
//files.watcherExclude: Keeps secret-shaped files out of the editor's index, which is what most AI assistants read for context.
//telemetry: Off. Editor telemetry can carry file paths and, in some extensions, snippets.
//trust: Workspace trust ON. Opening an untrusted repo must not auto-run tasks or extensions.
//autoexec: Never auto-run tasks on folder open — a malicious repo's tasks.json is a code-execution primitive.
//git: Refuse to commit as an unknown identity; require signed commits where configured.
